title: The Loose Cover
author: C. M. Oyelaran
blurb: Mirabel Iversen, a whistle-blower living under four names, works cases no one wants attributed. But when a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
